svg.title: Where to put your two cameras, seen from above
svg.desc: A desk seen from above. You sit at the desk with your computer in front of you, its camera showing your face. A second device on a stand sits at ninety degrees to your side, far enough back that its camera covers you, your hands, the keyboard, your screen and the space around you.
svg.text: Directly to your left or right — not behind you.
An examiner must see your hands and your screen at once. Both devices stay on Zoom throughout.
